svg.aria-label: Your computer drawn as a fenced yard holding your AI app and Svipall's hat. Svipall goes out through the gate to one site in the field, flights.example.com and then fares.example.net; each page comes back to the hat and on to your AI app. Outside the fence, three empty places: no sign-up, no key to paste, no server in between.
svg.text: Pages go from the site to you, then to your AI app. Nothing in between.
